name: DL-eutylone
summary: Eutylone is a stimulant and empathogenic drug of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, phenylisobutylamine, and cathinone families. It was developed in the 1960s and first reported to the EMCDDA in 2014. Eutylone is a designer drug which became widespread internationally in 2019–2020 following bans on the related compound ephylone. It is a synthetic cathinone.

uses.text: Eutylone is a designer drug which became widespread internationally in 2019–2020 following bans on the related compound ephylone.

pharmacology.en: It blocks the reuptake of dopamine and noradrenaline, and acts as a releaser of serotonin, a mixed action shared with some other cathinones.
pharmacology.zh: 它會阻斷多巴胺與正腎上腺素的再回收，同時促進血清素釋放，這種混合作用也見於其他部分卡西酮類。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它会阻断多巴胺与正肾上腺素的再回收，同时促进血清素释放，这种混合作用也见于其他部分卡西酮类。

sideEffects.en: Common effects include a fast heart rate, high blood pressure, sweating, jaw clenching, insomnia, agitation and paranoia. Serious harms include overheating, seizures and deaths, and it often leads to compulsive redosing.
sideEffects.zh: 常見反應包括心跳加快、血壓升高、出汗、咬牙、失眠、躁動與被害妄想。嚴重危害包括體溫過高、癲癇發作與死亡，而且常讓人忍不住一再追加使用。
sideEffects.zhHans: 常见反应包括心跳加快、血压升高、出汗、咬牙、失眠、躁动与被害妄想。严重危害包括体温过高、癫痫发作与死亡，而且常让人忍不住一再追加使用。

fact.en: Its name blends ethyl and butylone: it is butylone with an ethyl group in place of a methyl group on the nitrogen atom.
fact.zh: Eutylone的名字結合了「乙基」與「butylone」：它就是把butylone氮原子上的甲基換成乙基的產物。
fact.zhHans: Eutylone的名字结合了「乙基」与「butylone」：它就是把butylone氮原子上的甲基换成乙基的产物。
